checks.message: Package type is professional_design_package as required.
Bilingual contract satisfied: primary narrative in zh; en translation present.
All required proposal sections are present: three-level scope, research scope, design scope, key area detailed design, indicators, compliance, and risk.
All design geometry layers (buildings, roads, green_space, public_space, land_use, key_areas, phasing) fall within or are clipped to the provisional site boundary.
Land use zones are non-overlapping; topology validated.
Land use zones cover the full design scope area without gaps.
Metric values are internally consistent: green_ratio = green_space_area / site_area; public_space_ratio = public_space_area / site_area; key_area_total = sum of three key areas.
Static HTML visualization is self-contained with no external network dependencies.
All five required proposal figures are present: site-overview, key-areas, land-use-structure, metrics-evidence, mobility-bluegreen.
12 sources registered with id, type, usage_note, and path or url.
12 assumptions documented with id, title, detail, scope, impact, and mitigation.
All 23 requirement IDs mapped to report sections, geometry layers, metrics, drawings, visual sections, sources, assumptions, and self-check items.
All 6 professional standards mapped to proposal sections, drawings, geometry, metrics, sources, and evidence summaries.
All 15 design depth items documented with status, evidence refs, and professional dimension.
Provisional boundary usage is explicitly disclosed in ASSUMP-001 and A-CONTROLS-001; replacement with official data is documented as required mitigation.
A3 booklet and A0 board PDFs are present in the drawings directory.
Copyright statement is present and declares AI agent authorship.
